# DSH Perplexity Guard · Perplexity 修正器
保住 DeepSeek Harness 嘅 **Perplexity API** 路線：幫 Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5 同 GPT-6.1 Sol 補齊 out
put cap、避開撞名工具、修好 schema，仲可以一撳修復 provider 設定。
> Repo 名係歷史原因叫 `dsh-perplexity-api-fix-plugin`；plugin 套件名係 `@local/perplexity-guard`。
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Host + Web plugin that keeps the **Perplexity API** route working for Claud
e Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, and repairs the provider settings that commonly make
e Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, and repairs the provider settings that commonly make those calls fail.
> Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with Perplexity, Anthropic, OpenAI or DeepSeek.
## What it fixes
On every request sent to the `perplexity` provider (configurable) it:
| Problem | Fix |
| Anthropic models reject calls without an output cap | Fills `maxTokens` (sent as `max_output_token

s`), capped to the remaining context window |
| DSH tool names that collide with Perplexity built-in
s (`web_search`, `fetch_url`, `sandbox`, …) return HTTP 400 | Renames them on the wire to `dsh_<name

>` and restores the original name in the streamed tool calls |
| Tool schemas with `type: "object"`
but no `properties`, or empty descriptions, return HTTP 400 | Adds `properties: {}` / a default desc

ription (arguments are never touched) |
| `stop`, out-of-range `temperature`, unsupported `reasoning
Effort` | Removes or clamps them |
It also adds:
- **Sidebar page** ("Perplexity") showing the provider route, a settings check, and the last 40 rewr

ites/errors.
- **Repair settings** button / `perplexity_guard` agent tool (`action: "status" | "repa

ir"`). Repair fills in, for the three focus models:
`api: openai-responses`, `baseURL` (only if miss

ing, defaults to `https://api.perplexity.ai/v1`), `maxTokens`, `contextWindow`,
`reasoningEfforts` (

low/medium/high/xhigh), `compat.supportsMaxOutputTokens`, and a 15-minute stream idle timeout.
It ne
ver removes other models and never replaces a custom base URL.
## What it does *not* do
- It does not change message content. A `finish_reason=refusal` from Perplexity is a content-moderat

ion decision upstream; the plugin only logs it.
- It does not store or read your API key.
## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.5`
- The `llm-pi-ai` provider configured with a provider id `perplexity` (or set

`providerId` in the plugin config)
- A Perplexity API key configured in that provider

## Config
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | Turn live request repair on/off |
| `providerId` | `perplexity` | Which provi

der id to guard |
| `defaultMaxTokens` | `32768` | Output cap used when a call has none |
| `context

Window` | `200000` | Fallback context window when model info is unavailable |
| `headroomTokens` | `
4096` | Safety margin kept free when capping output |
## Known limitation
When a request has to be rewritten (tool aliasing / schema repair), the plugin re-enters `ctx.llm.st
ream()` with the copy, because the public middleware API does not expose a replacement-options `next
()`. The re-entered call uses the *current* adapter, so if you edit the provider config in the middl
e of a stream that one call may pick up the new settings.
## Changelog
- **1.0.3** — `perplexity_guard status` no longer emits `error: undefined`, which DSH rejected as "v

alue is not lossless JSON". Doc comment fix.
- **1.0.2** — initial public version.
